summary: The proof is correct and complete. The fiber-volume sequences are finitely supported, interval-supported, log-concave, and unimodal by convexity and Brunn-Minkowski; the weighted-median fiber and its centroid are valid; vertical boundary mass is handled separately; nonvertical boundary mass is null fiberwise; Grünbaum's inequality gives the required bound on the bad portion of the median fiber; the accepted log-concave threshold lemma applies exactly to the selected ray; and both possible rays have mass at least T/2. Boundary reduction then covers all containing halfspaces. The monotonicity argument and all stated numerical specializations are also correct.
